_note: 和牛以外の肉の系譜。品目ハブ（/en/eat/meat/）の横並び表と、各系譜ページがここから描く。出典は docs/research/meat-minor-2026-10-10.md と各系譜ページの sources。和牛は wagyu.json、とんかつは tonkatsu.json、豚丼は donburi.json（planned）、ラフテーは kyodo-ryori-okinawa にある。ジビエ（鹿・猪）の衛生ルールは meat-basashi のページ内で扱い、独立ページは planned。アグー・生姜焼きはメモで未確認のため行を作っていない。価格はメモで1つも確認できていない
name: Meat beyond wagyu
nameJa: 和牛以外の肉（豚・羊・馬・ジビエ）

lineages.name: Pork: kurobuta, butadon, kakuni
lineages.nameJa: 豚（かごしま黒豚・帯広の豚丼・長崎の角煮）

origin.era: kurobuta brand from 1955–64; butadon early Shōwa

cells.meat: Berkshire black pork; over 400 pork brands are said to exist, with no common standard
cells.eaten: Obihiro: grilled pork in an eel-style tare over rice. Nagasaki: skin-on belly simmered sweet
cells.rules: Kagoshima kurobuta: Berkshire only, kept apart, fed 10–20% sweet potato for 60 days or more before shipping
cells.marker: Kagoshima black pork was sent live to Tokyo in 1955–64 and became Japan’s first pork brand

origin.era: devised early Shōwa; spread after the war (accounts differ)

cells.meat: Lamb (under a year) or mutton (two years or more); domestic meat was 0.5% of supply in FY2022
cells.eaten: Grilled on a domed pan, vegetables round the edge catching the juices
cells.rules: Two styles: marinated before grilling (Takikawa) or dipped after (Sapporo)
cells.marker: Born in Hokkaido, not Mongolia, says the farm ministry; 58% of Japan’s sheep are in Hokkaido

lineages.name: Basashi (raw horse)
lineages.nameJa: 馬刺し（熊本・山梨・会津）

cells.meat: Raw horse, called sakura-niku; the reason for the name is disputed
cells.eaten: Kumamoto: sweet soy with onion, ginger, garlic. Aizu: soy with karashi-miso
cells.rules: Kumamoto horse meat is always frozen before distribution; labels separate Kumamoto-born from imported foals raised there
cells.marker: In Aizu, sashimi can mean horse; it is mostly eaten at home

cells.meat: Wild deer and boar, hunted in part because of crop damage
cells.eaten: Cooked through; never raw or underdone
cells.rules: 75°C at the centre for at least one minute; shops must buy from licensed meat-processing facilities
cells.marker: A national certification scheme for processing facilities
